Ingest_LDD.name: Deep Impact and EPOXI Missions Dictionary
Ingest_LDD.comment: Created as part of the PDS3 to PDS4 conversion of the Deep Impact, EPOCh, and DIXI mission archives.

DD_Attribute.name: adc_saturated_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:adc_saturated_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels where the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) was saturated.

DD_Attribute.name: bad_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:bad_pixel_count attribute provides a count of the number of bad pixels as identified by the Deep Impact calibration process. This count includes any VIS overclock pixels or IR reference pixels at the borders of the image.

DD_Attribute.name: commanded_image_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:commanded_image_count provides the number of images intended to be acquired acquired by the imaging command that resulted in the associated data product.

DD_Attribute.name: data_to_calibrated_dn_multiplier
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:data_to_calibrated_dn_multipler provides the scaling factor for converting the image data from the currently specified unit to calibrated data numbers (DN), before the conversion to radiance units. A value of 1 indicates the current image is already in units of raw data number.

DD_Attribute.name: data_to_ioverf_multiplier
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:data_to_ioverf_multiplier provides the scaling factor for converting the image data from the currently specified unit to unitless I-over-F data. A value of 1 indicates the current image is already in units of I-over-F.

DD_Attribute.name: data_to_radiance_multiplier
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:data_to_radiance_multiplier provides the scaling factor for converting the image data from the currently specified unit to radiance data, W/(m**2*micron*sr). A value of 1 indicates the current image is already in units of radiance.

DD_Attribute.name: despiked_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:despiked_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels that were modified by the despiking routine in the calibration pipeline.

DD_Attribute.name: geometry_quality
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:geometry_quality_flag indicates the quality of the calculated geometric parameters. A value of BAD indicates some or all values could not be calculated or the values may not be accurate and should be used with caution.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Some or all of the associated geometric values could not be calculated, or the values may not be accurate and should be used with caution.
The associated geometric values are considered accurate and reliable.

DD_Attribute.name: image_compression_history
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:image_compression_history attribute indicates whether the associated iamge data were compressed aboard the spacecraft, and if so, whether they are still in that compressed state.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The image was compressed onboard the spacecraft and archived in that compressed form.
The image was compressed onboard the spacecraft and then decompressed as part of calibration.
The image was never compressed onboard the spacecraft.

DD_Attribute.name: image_number
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:image_number provides the sequential number for an image within an observation. For EPOXI data, multiple images could have been associated with a single di:observation_id.

DD_Attribute.name: instrument_mode
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:instrument_mode attribute provides the human-readable expansion of the di:instrument_mode_mnemonic field, and corresponds to the di:instrument_mode_id for the particular instrument.

CCD Mode 2 - Sub-Frame 1 (shuttered)
CCD Mode 3 - Sub-Frame 2 (shuttered)
CCD Mode 4 - Sub-Frame 2 (unshuttered)
CCD Mode 5 - Sub-Frame 3 (shuttered)
CCD Mode 6 - Sub-Frame 3 (unshuttered)
CCD Mode 7 - Sub-Frame 4 (unshuttered), one parallel overclock row
CCD Mode 8 - Sub-Frame 4 (unshuttered), no parallel overclock row
CCD Mode 9 - Diagnostic (shuttered)
HRI Spectrometer Mode 1 - Binned Full Frame

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: HRI Spectrometer Mode 6 - Diagnostic: One reset frame followed by a read frame
HRI Spectrometer Mode 7 - Memory Check

DD_Attribute.name: instrument_mode_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:instrument_mode_id is a number indicating the operating mode of the instrument during the associated observation. It corresponds to the instrument_mode_mnemonic and the instrument_mode. Instrument modes for the CCD instruments (HRIV, MRI, and ITS) are all the same. The HRII spectrometer has its own set of modes.

DD_Attribute.name: instrument_mode_mnemonic
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:instrument_mode_mnemonic corresponds to the di:instrument_mode_id and the di:instrument_mode, which should also be present. The CCD instruments (HTIV, MRI, and ITS) all use the same set of mode IDs, mnemonics, and names. The HRII spectrometer has its own set. The instrument modes were identical for primary and extended missions.

CCD Mode 2 - Sub-Frame 1 (shuttered)

HRI Spectrometer Mode 3 - Binned Sub-Frame 2
HRI Spectrometer Mode 4 - Un-binned Full Frame
HRI Spectrometer Mode 5 - Alternating Binned Full Frame
HRI Spectrometer Mode 6 - Diagnostic: One reser frame followed by a read frame
HRI Spectrometer Mode 7 - Memory Check

DD_Attribute.name: interpolated_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:interpolated_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels that were reclaimed, in the calibration pipeline, by interpolating from the values of neighgboring good pixels.

DD_Attribute.name: missing_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:missing_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels that were not received from the spacecraft and pixels that are the image header bytes.

DD_Attribute.name: mission_activity
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:mission_activity attribute provides a human-readable tag for the context of an observation (for example, "Daily Science Imaging").

DD_Attribute.name: mission_phase_name
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:mission_phase_name is the name of a specific mission phase, as defined in the mission documentation.

DD_Attribute.name: observation_description
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:observation_description provides a brief, human-readable description elucidating the di:observation_id value. This corresponds to the PDS3 keyword OBSERVATION_TYPE.

DD_Attribute.name: observation_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:observation_id is a numeric string identifying a specific calibration-related or scientific observation. A single 'observation' may consist of more than one image (the di:image_number provides the sequence number within the observation for a specific image). In the EPOXI missions, a calibration sequence was often reused, so that the same observation_id might appear more than once within a data collection.

DD_Attribute.name: partial_saturated_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:partial_saturated_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels where the raw DN value is above the point where some pixels have reached partial saturation. For the VIS CCD instruments this point occurs at 11,000 raw DN and at 8,000 raw DN for the HRII IR spectrometer.

DD_Attribute.name: pointing_description
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:pointing_desc provides the planned spacecraft pointing as described in an imaging sequence.

DD_Attribute.name: product_type
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:product_type attribute provides a categorization for the data product based on its state of reduction.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The associated data product is an Edited (or 'Experiment') Data Record (EDR). This is the product_type associated with raw data. The data are in a format suitable for analysis, but no processing or calibration has been performed. This corresponds to CODMAC level 2 edited data.

The associated data product has been processed to radiance values in a method that is reversible - specifically, the processing did not include cleaning (removing cosmic rays, interpolating over bad pixels, etc.). This corresponds to CODMAC level 3 calibrated data.

The associated data product has been cleaned (cosmic ray hits removed, interpolation over bad pixels, etc.) and processed to radiance values. Because of the cleaning applied, this calibration is not reversible. This corresponds to CODMAC level 4 calibrated/resampled data.

DD_Attribute.name: saturated_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:saturated_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels where the raw DN value is above the point where some pixels have reached full-well saturation. For the VIS CCD instruments this point occurs 15,000 raw DN and at 11,000 raw DN for the HRII IR spectrometer.

DD_Attribute.name: scaled_maximum
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:scaled_maximum indicates the largest value occurring within the image itself after the application of any scaling factor and offset. In the final DI/EPOXI pipelines, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: scaled_median
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:scaled_median provides the median value (middle value) occurring in the image itself after the application of any scaling factor and offset. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: scaled_minimum
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:scaled_minimum indicates the smallest value occurring in the image itself after the application of any scaling factor and offset. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: scaled_standard_deviation
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:scaled_standard_deviation provides the standard deviation occurring in the image itself after the application of any scaling factor and offset. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: sdc_pipeline_file_name
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:sdc_pipeline_file_name provides the original file name used by the EPOXI Science Data Center (SDC) pipeline and typically used in publications; the project elected to use shorter file names for the PDS archive. The formation rule for this element is iicccccccccc_eeeeeee_nnn_rr.FIT where ii identifies the instrument (HV=HRIV,HI=HRII,MV=MRI,IV=ITS), cccccccccc is the spacecraft clock count at the mid-point of the observation, eeeeeee is the exposure ID (OBSERVATION_ID in data labels), nnn provides the sequentially increasing image number within an exposure ID (IMAGE_NUMBER in the data labels), and rr identifies the type of reduction (no string = raw DN, RADREV = reversibly calibrated in radiance units, RAD = irreversibly calibrated in radiance units, IFREV = reversibly calibrated I/F (unitless), IF = irreversibly calibrated I/F (unitless).

DD_Attribute.name: sensor_location
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:sensor_location is the string provided in the original PDS3 label, which in turn was extracted from comments in the FITS header of the file, that briefly describes where a particular temperature or voltage sensor was located.

DD_Attribute.name: spacecraft_clock_mid
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:spacecraft_clock_mid gives the spacecraft clock reading at the midpoint of an interval. The format and interpretation of the spacecraft clock string varies from mission to mission. The Deep Impact Flyby spacecraft clock is represented as a string of the format '1/0123456789.123'.

DD_Attribute.name: spacecraft_clock_start
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:spacecraft_clock_start gives the spacecraft clock reading at the beginning of an interval. The format and interpretation of the spacecraft clock string varies from mission to mission. The Deep Impact Flyby spacecraft clock is represented as a string of the format '1/0123456789.123'.

DD_Attribute.name: spacecraft_clock_stop
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:spacecraft_clock_stop gives the spacecraft clock reading at the end of an interval. The format and interpretation of the spacecraft clock string varies from mission to mission. The Deep Impact Flyby spacecraft clock is represented as a string of the format '1/0123456789.123'.

DD_Attribute.name: spacecraft_processor_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:spacecraft_processor_id attribute identifies which of two onboard processors was user ti acquire and record the associated observation.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The 'A' processor was used to obtain the data.
The 'B' processor was used to obtain the data.

DD_Attribute.name: stored_maximum
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:stored_maximum indicates the largest value occurring within the the stored pixel values of the image itself. In the final DI/EPOXI pipelines, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: stored_median
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:stored_median provides the median value (middle value) occurring within the stored pixels of the image itself. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: stored_minimum
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:stored_minimum indicates the smallest value occurring in the stored pixels of the image itself. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: stored_standard_deviation
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:stored_standard_deviation provides the standard deviation of the values occurring in the stored pixels of the image itself. In the final DI/EPOXI pipeline, pixels in the overclock areas bordering the VIS CCDs or pixels in the reference rows and columns bordering the HRI IR spectrometer are included in the image object but are excluded from the value. Values are stated as real numbers regardless of the data type of the elements of the associated image.

DD_Attribute.name: temperature
DD_Attribute.definition: di:temperature is the temperature reported by the associated sensor, indicated by the accompanying di:sensor_location.

DD_Attribute.name: ultracompressed_pixel_count
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:ultracompressed_pixel_count provides a count of the number of pixels where the raw DN is in a compression bin so large that the resulting value contains very little information.

DD_Attribute.name: voltage
DD_Attribute.definition: di:voltage is the voltage reported by the associated sensor, indicated by the accompanying di:sensor_location.

DD_Attribute.name: x_axis_rotation
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:x_axis_rotation attributed provides the rate of rotation about the X-axis of the spacecraft.

DD_Attribute.name: y_axis_rotation
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:y_axis_rotation attributed provides the rate of rotation about the Y-axis of the spacecraft.

DD_Attribute.name: z_axis_rotation
DD_Attribute.definition: The di:z_axis_rotation attributed provides the rate of rotation about the Z-axis of the spacecraft.

DD_Class.name: Conversion_Constants
DD_Class.definition: The di:Conversion_Constants class provides multiplicative constants for transforming pixel values in the associated image from their current units to other units.

DD_Class.name: Geometry
DD_Class.definition: The di:Geometry class provides additional geometry information not accommodated by the Geometry discipline namespace.

DD_Class.name: Imaging
DD_Class.definition: The di:Imaging class contains attributes related to the sequence that produced the data comprising the product observation.

DD_Class.name: Image_Statistics
DD_Class.definition: The di:Image_Statistics class provides various counts, metrics and conversion constants for the image contained within the primary data object.

DD_Class.name: Instrument_Parameters
DD_Class.definition: The di:Instrument_Parameters class provides attributes specific to instrument settings and environment.

DD_Class.name: Instrument_Temperatures
DD_Class.definition: The di:Instrument_Temperatures class contains a list of reported temperature measurements from specific sensors located in various places in the spacecraft hardware.

DD_Class.name: Instrument_Voltages
DD_Class.definition: The di:Instrument_Voltages class contains a list of reported voltage measurements from specific sensors located in various places in the spacecraft hardware.

DD_Class.name: Observation_Parameters
DD_Class.definition: The di:Observation_Parameters class contains details specific to the observations comprising the data product, including planning and commanding attributes, and additional pointing information not covered by the Geometry discipline classes.

DD_Class.name: Temperature_Measurement
DD_Class.definition: The di:Temperature_Measurement class reports a single temperature reading by a specific sensor.

DD_Class.name: Voltage_Measurement
DD_Class.definition: The di:Voltage_Measurement class reports a single voltage reading by a specific sensor.

DD_Class.name: Mission_Parameters
DD_Class.definition: The di:Mission_Parameters class is the container class for the subclasses comprising the namespace shared by the Deep Impact and EPOXI missions.
